title: Evidence-Guided Neural Architecture Selection under Uncertainty for Subject-Specific Blood Glucose Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2606.05373v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reliable neural architecture selection is an open challenge in time-series forecasting under limited, noisy, and heterogeneous data, where standard heuristic architecture design and validation approaches fail to ensure accurate and reliable prediction and generalization. We propose EVIDENT (EVidence-based IDEntification of Neural archiTectures), a framework for architecture selection that integrates Bayesian training, evidence-based ranking, and task-specific validation under uncertainty. The framework explores the candidate architecture pool and identifies the lowest-capacity model that satisfies a prescribed validation criterion. We demonstrate this method using temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for individualized blood glucose forecasting in type 1 diabetes patients. translated_title: 不确定性下基于证据引导的神经架构选择用于个体化血糖预测
translated_abstract: 在数据有限、含噪且异构的时间序列预测任务中，可靠的神经架构选择仍是一个悬而未决的挑战，标准的启发式架构设计与验证方法无法确保预测的准确性、可靠性及泛化能力。我们提出了EVIDENT（基于证据的神经架构识别），一个用于架构选择的框架，它集成了贝叶斯训练、基于证据的排序以及不确定性下的任务特定验证。该框架探索候选架构池，并识别出满足预定验证准则的容量最低的模型。我们使用时间卷积网络（TCN）在1型糖尿病患者的个体化血糖预测任务中对该方法进行了验证。结果表明，EVIDENT在人群水平的糖尿病数据上系统性地拒绝参数不足和参数过多的TCN架构，同时为个体受试者识别出更合适的架构。
tldr: 提出了EVIDENT框架，通过结合贝叶斯训练、基于证据的排序和不确定性下的任务特定验证，自动为1型糖尿病个体化血糖预测选出满足验证准则且容量最低的TCN架构。
en_tdlr: EVIDENT, a framework integrating Bayesian training, evidence-based ranking, and uncertainty-aware task-specific validation, automatically identifies the lowest-capacity TCN architecture satisfying a validation criterion for personalized blood glucose forecasting in type 1 diabetes.
